mechanism: Use native CUDA block reductions with coalesced row-major half2-friendly access for forward/dx and a coalesced column-tile dweight kernel.
expected_effect: Lower compiler overhead/register pressure and improve dweight coalescing relative to Triton one-program-per-column mapping.
resource_tradeoff: One fp32 inverse-RMS per row; no full-size workspace.
ablation_plan: reject before official if regression exceeds 10 percent
